shared_elements: frontal standing/anthropomorphic figure occupying the whole monolith
elaborate headdress or headgear at the top
large ornament/pendant on the chest (disc or medallion)
carving in low relief on a tall upright slab-like stone
arms held against the body with hands near the waist/chest
symmetrical frontal composition with vertical axis
justification: Both depict a single frontal anthropomorphic figure carved in low relief filling a tall upright monolith, with a broad headdress/cap above, a prominent circular chest ornament, and arms folded in toward the torso, and both use a rigid symmetrical vertical composition. However A shows a slender full-length figure in an ornate feathered costume with a fully articulated body and feet on a defined ground line plus flanking dense glyph-like detail, whereas B is a squat massive block with a huge simplified head, no legs, and much coarser, more abstract surface motifs, so the specific costume elements and proportions differ substantially.
